text: ITEM 1 | Single piece of cooked meat with golden-brown, slightly glossy, crisp-looking skin in orange-brown tones, with pale creamy-white exposed flesh at the thin end and a small rounded knob of pale meat at the far tip; the surface shows small pale granular specks scattered over it, roughly 9 cm long by 5 cm wide at its widest, irregular and lumpy in shape, slightly thicker at the body and tapering to a narrow bone-like end, sitting alone in the center-top area of a large white square plate with no sauce or garnish beside it | 110
